root_causes.name: Database access & privilege inventory (logins, roles, grants)
root_causes.description: Enumerates, for every online user database on the instance, each database principal mapped to its server login, the database roles it belongs to, and its explicit permission grants - a Server -> Database -> Login -> roles & grants inventory for access review.
root_causes.resolution: Review the inventory for over-privileged or orphaned principals: logins in high-privilege roles (db_owner, db_securityadmin), broad GRANTs, users with no mapped login (orphaned), and stale accounts. Right-size grants toward least privilege.

expected.description: Database principals with their roles and permission grants across all user databases
